3.Sub-event_summary: Hitler meets with Jodl at Wolfschanze, assesses global threats including potential defections and front instabilities, and, influenced by the recent assassination attempt, decides to personally direct the war and plan a withdrawal from France.

6.Sub-event_summary: Allied optimism justified by Turkey breaking relations in August, Rumania, Bulgaria, Finland negotiating peace. Allies advanced beyond 1918 lines. Initial German chaos in September, but by 10 September continuous front formed. In Italy, Germans retreated; Russians neared Germany; Pacific advances converged on Philippines; Burma successes. Quebec conference mid-September discussed occupations. Southern France forces captured Dijon on 10 September, meeting OVERLORD troops; 6th Army Group operational 15 September, forming continuous front from Netherlands to Switzerland.
